task_description: Implement Phase 8: dootd (Production Daemon) for the Doot DSL compiler. This phase implements production mode (doot --prod) with a web dashboard, app management, GitHub integration, env var validation, child process supervision, host-header routing, cgroups isolation, systemd registration, and password management.

verification.summary: nim c src/doot.nim compiles successfully (90680 lines). 236 tests in test_dootd.nim all pass. 82 tests in test_cli.nim all pass (no regression). Code review approved on v3 after two rounds of fixes (7 issues in v1, 4 in v2, 0 in v3). All tests exercise real code paths.
